info.description: REST API for the Secret Santa application
info.title: My Secret Santa API

post.description: Authenticate with username and password to receive JWT tokens
Exchange the authorization code received from Google OAuth callback for JWT access and refresh tokens. Creates a new user account if one doesn't exist for the Google email.

is_new_user.description: True if account was just created

500.description: Google OAuth not configured or Google API error

post.summary: Exchange Google OAuth authorization code for JWT tokens.

get.description: Get the Google OAuth authorization URL. The frontend should redirect the user to this URL to initiate the OAuth flow.

parameters.description: The URI where Google should redirect after authorization (must be registered in Google Console)
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.description: Optional state parameter to pass through the OAuth flow (e.g., for deep linking)
parameters.name: state

get.summary: Generate Google OAuth authorization URL for frontend.

post.summary:
Accept a group or admin invite using the invite code.

The invite code is sent via email and determines the type of invite:
- GROUP-* : Adds user to a group as a regular member
- ADMIN-* : Adds user to a group as an admin

get.description: Get the current user's secret santa relationships across all groups

santas.description: Groups where someone is your secret santa

santees.description: People you are the secret santa for

get.summary:
Get the current user's santa and santee relationships.

Returns:
    - santas: People who are buying gifts FOR the current user
    - santees: People the current user is buying gifts for

get.description: Reveal who your secret santa is for a specific group. Includes decoy names for a fun reveal experience. Only works if the group admin has enabled reveals.

parameters.description: Name of the group to reveal secret santa for
parameters.name: group_name

decoy_usernames.description: Random member names for reveal animation

get.summary:
Reveal who the current user's secret santa is for a specific group.

Returns the santa's username along with decoy usernames for a fun reveal experience.

Query parameters:
    - group_name: The name of the group to reveal for
